newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates close higher at 21.375 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates close higher at 21.375 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight interest rates rose slightly on the first day of the banks' two-week reserve period but money supply remained abundant, traders said on Monday.
"There is no shortage at the moment," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
Overnight rates traded between 21.00 to 21.50 percent and closed at 21.375 percent compared with Friday's close of 21.00 percent.
Kalman added that panic withdrawals (of almost 21 billion forints over the weekend) from Postabank did not affect the overnight rates. -- Denes Albert, Budapest newsroom +36 1 327 4040
